title: Signal and Machine Anew
author: Ada Hartwell
blurb: Paloma Brightwater, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
